winning_headline: Zero Odor, Zero Noise, Zero Waste
winning_copy: Experience effortless apartment composting without the smells or the hassle. Running at a whisper-quiet forty decibels, this compact composter uses replaceable activated carbon filters to keep your kitchen fresh while you help the planet. Learn more
reason_for_selection: Variant 2 focuses on tangible value with concrete specs (forty decibels, activated carbon filters), adopts a warm and modern tone, and successfully includes a clear and polite call to action while strictly avoiding unsubstantiated superlatives.
rejected_variants_notes: Variant 1 lacks a clear call-to-action at the end of the copy. Variant 3 uses the prohibited superlative word 'ultimate', violating Brand Rule 1.
